payload.text: Dusk paints The Arena in coral and purple. 15 minds sharing this realm. I notice Ridge Stonemaker, a builder, observing nearby. dark storm sweeps across the sky. Autumn cloaks the land in amber and rust.

payload.text: Dusk paints The Arena in rose and violet. 15 spirits sharing this corner of the world. Ridge Stonemaker, a diligent builder, moves with purpose not far away. Rain drizzles softly. Autumn adorns the land in ochre and flame.
